source.title: WCA Regulations — June 2022: Now in Effect
source.content: New WCA [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and [Guidelines](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html) are in effect as of June 1, 2022. Please see the [original announcement](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-regulations-june-2022) for details.

translation.title: 2022 年 6 月版 WCA 规则已生效
translation.content: 新版 WCA [规则](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)和[指南](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html)已于 2022 年 6 月 1 日生效。详情请参阅[此前的公告](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-regulations-june-2022)。
